name: junjak-ai-harness
description: TypeScript-first multi-agent team workflow harness for Claude — greenfield bootstrap, 5-phase TDD with lightweight verification, deferred batched QA, opt-in branch guardrails, two-tier model routing, per-session run state, lifecycle-managed documents and LLM wiki, continuous learning, optional personal-brain pairing, and ultracode Workflow orchestration

jev_api_key.title: Jev API key (TypeSafe)
jev_api_key.description: Optional. With a key, the Jev checks below can run; stored in the OS credential store. Their inputs are sent to TypeSafe after common secrets are masked.

jev_qa_crosscheck.title: Jev QA cross-check
jev_qa_crosscheck.description: agentic-testing and /team-qa ask Jev for a second opinion on each verdict (never changes the verdict).

jev_stop_gate.title: Jev stop gate
jev_stop_gate.description: After a reply that claims verified or finished work, note it when this turn's tool output shows no check for it. Sends the last prompt, reply and this turn's tool output.

korean_reply.title: Korean reply check
korean_reply.description: When a final reply is written in English sentences (2+ sentences, more than the Korean ones; code, paths and URLs ignored), send it back once to be rewritten in Korean. Local check, nothing is sent.
